bio: Once home to the I Pupi restaurant, and run by the same team, this “new generation” osteria takes its name from chef Lo Coco’s children, Turi and Emma. The cuisine here is in the hands of the sous-chef, who pays tribute to Sicily and its glorious, colourful culinary traditions: caponata, aubergine balls, swordfish rolls and the catch of the day all feature on the menu. In summer, tables are laid out in the quiet alleyway behind the restaurant....
